title: Operations Manager
trigger_line: Delaware Valley Sample Logistics publishes a customer portal and paperwork requirements for shipments.

emails.subject: paperwork questions at Delaware Valley Logistics
emails.body: Delaware Valley Sample Logistics has real paperwork requirements for every shipment, which means your team likely answers the same status and document questions all day. We build AI systems, trained on your own documents, that answer those so your people handle the exceptions. Interested in a free 20-minute call with our CEO, Joaquin Garcia? We can send a 2-minute Loom if you'd rather see it first.

emails.subject: re: paperwork questions
emails.body: Quick follow-up. What we build is trained on your own documents, live in 21 days, and run with a named human operator. A low-risk first step is our AI Audit. The free 20-minute call will tell us quickly if it's worth your time.

emails.subject: last note
emails.body: Last note from us. If answering the same customer questions is still eating your day, book a time at {{booking_link}}. No pressure either way, and thanks for reading this far, Elena.
